PAYLOAD SAFETY STATION
ARCHIVED INSPECTION / 6079
INSPECTOR: MARA<New>A loaded cradle was moved
while a technician was still
checking its locks. No injury
reported.<New>The movement was ordered from
the control desk.<New>The operator could see the
cradle on the monitor. He
could not see the technician
behind it.<New>Do not accept a camera check
in place of clearance from
the loading crew.<New>Keep the movement key at the
cradle until the inspection
is finished.<New>FOLLOW-UP<New>Movement key retained by the
loading crew during the next
test. No further movement
orders received before
clearance.<Close>

PERSONNEL ACCESS DESK
ARCHIVED REGISTER / 6081
STRATEGIC LOADING AREA<New>ACCESS LIST REVISED
Civil project passes no
longer permit entry.
Strategic Command must
approve each visit.<New>ENTRY REFUSED
Lena / Guidance
Purpose: recover survey
equipment.<New>DESK NOTE<New>Her name is on the equipment
record, but not the access
list. Stores has confirmed
that the equipment belongs to
the civil project.<New>Request sent to Command. No
reply recorded before the end
of the shift.<Close>
